title: Samsung Galaxy Note8 handsets have a battery problem
text: Samsung Galaxy Note8 handsets have a battery problem Tuesday, 2 January 2018 ( 7 hours ago ) Sound familiar? A Galaxy Note has a problem with its battery! Samsung has acknowledged that there is an issue with the battery of the Galaxy Note8 -- but unlike the Galaxy Note7, there's no risk of it catching fire or exploding this time around. A number of Note8 owners have complained that their phones have essentially been bricked after they let the battery run flat. With the battery fully discharged, it has proved impossible to charge the phone again. The problem is mainly affecting Note8 owners in the US. And now an FCC filing seems to indicate the rumors could be true. According to Android Headlines phone model codes corresponding to the S9 and S9 Plus have popped up in an FCC database.
